description: Asks which DefaultValue expressions are accepted when set ('2+3' on Long, "'x' & 'y'" on Text, '1/0' on Double, '#2024-01-31# + 1' on Date, "'q'" on Long, 'Null' on Long). Then what an AddNew exposes in each field before any assignment, and what Update stores, both with only ID assigned and with A set to Null. Then SQL INSERT with the columns omitted versus A given as Null. The fixture is a writable copy. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
